primaryChecks.text: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
primaryChecks.previousContext: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

primaryChecks.text: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”
primaryChecks.previousContext: That same night, the LORD said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.

primaryChecks.text: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”
